name: dima-admin-api-dev
description: localtld launcher for the admin control-plane API (admin-api.dima.localtld). Ayrı process (ADR-0015): admin_app.main, Wren'siz. --app-dir .. ile paketler dima-backend kökünden çözülür; cwd burada kalır ki localtld .localtld alanını (admin-api.dima) okusun.

scripts.dev: if command -v localtld >/dev/null 2>&1; then localtld run -- sh -c '../.venv/bin/uvicorn admin_app.main:app --reload --app-dir .. --reload-dir ../admin_app --reload-dir ../control_plane --reload-dir ../app --port ${PORT:-8001}'; else ../.venv/bin/uvicorn admin_app.main:app --reload --app-dir .. --reload-dir ../admin_app --reload-dir ../control_plane --reload-dir ../app --port 8001; fi
